Hi Ilse, I can't set up a recurring 09:15 post from here. I have no scheduler in this workspace, so I can't promise the "North morning digest" will appear on its own every morning, and I don't want to say it will when it might not.

You're a member of both #north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1, so I can read both for you. If you ask me each morning, or someone pings me at 09:15, I'll post the digest in #north-team. It will cover anything new in those two channels from the previous day. If you can get a recurring trigger set up on your side, I'll handle the digest each time it fires.
